method: Direct inspection of decoded frames from unedited normal-camera raw captures, plus explicitly separate editor and installed-package environment fixture frames; exact source/build/input/telemetry retained separately
improved_boundary: The service-bay approach now has bevelled slab joints, inset side drains and wet patches reflecting the existing practical lamps. The former solid status-color hazard slab is replaced by steel plates with a worn perimeter stripe and small lenses driven by native power. The ground is visible from the ordinary approach camera; close fixture views preserve safe and powered states. This improves local material/state separation but the blotchy grid-shaped wetness remains below the required quality.

major_defects.finding: Blue/yellow/red mannequin presentation, primitive infected body and block-like weapon remain in the focal encounter.
The service bay gains authored construction detail, but the approach remains a broad empty road with repeated facades and primitive interior structure; dense vertical industrial layers are absent.

The service floor gains slab/drain geometry and localized reflections, but its wetness reads as conspicuous blotchy grid-shaped patches. The abrupt rectangular transition to the dry road, whole-panel damage tint, primitive switch interface and flat surrounding surfaces still fail coherent material quality.

The approach column/header now carry visible dark-red tissue and vascular branches. Close views still read as smooth rubbery, repetitive lobes with luminous seams, and the surrounding arena has sparse organic coverage. This local improvement does not establish a convincing coherent invasion.
Two motivated warm task lamps now illuminate the panels, but clear daylight and exposed sky still lack the required cold storm atmosphere and coherent scene-wide lighting contrast.

unproven: Current 720p and 1080p ordinary runs reach Success before the switch; neither proves power, panel physics or player electrical-floor damage. Package-04 ordinary consequence remains separately preserved. Current package-06 fixture verifies those native behaviors but does not establish the full evolving player+rival+infected+arena composition. No natural arena_pressure transition is observed.
Interior, terrace and east-return beats were not reached before terminal state.
HUD occlusion during required later dense-combat states remains unqualified.
No final temporal-quality or raw audio qualification is claimed.
scope: Preserves accepted mechanics evidence; rejects current final visual quality. Does not reopen predecessor task acceptance.
